patterns.note: A dominant, vibrant pink palette is used for backgrounds and accents, creating a strong brand identity, contrasted with a muted olive green for a key call-to-action section.
Content is primarily centered on the page, with full-bleed background colors defining distinct sections, creating clear visual breaks.

Initial abstract pink blocks animate upwards and off-screen, revealing the product. Subsequent content sections, including the product can, certification icons, and text, slide up into view from the bottom as the user scrolls.
A unique 'up arrow' icon acts as a persistent scroll indicator, transforming in size and position from a large central element to a smaller decorative one as the user progresses down the page.
A single, clean sans-serif font is used throughout, with headings significantly larger and bolder than body text, maintaining a modern and legible hierarchy.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations are used to orchestrate a sequential reveal of content. Initial hero elements animate off-screen upwards, while subsequent sections and the main product image slide into the viewport from the bottom as the user scrolls.
A custom scroll indicator icon dynamically changes its scale and vertical position based on scroll depth, guiding the user through the page's narrative.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are substantially larger and bolder (~3-4x body text) than the body copy, creating a clear, modern sans-serif hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on input fields, otherwise sharp edges dominate the design.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with an airy initial hero section transitioning to more compact content blocks further down the page.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost monochromatic pink color scheme, which is consistently applied and immediately memorable. This is combined with a playful, interactive scroll experience where abstract shapes give way to a product reveal, guided by a transforming scroll indicator, making the initial engagement highly unique.
